name: card-print-sheets
description: Turn a folder of card images into print-ready sheets for board games, tarot, flash cards or business cards. Pick a card size (poker, bridge, tarot, mini, business, square or your own), add bleed, gap, paper and crop marks, and set how many copies of each card to print — from a counts sheet or by editing. Double-sided printing places a mirrored back page after each front page so backs line up on long- or short-edge flip, with a different back per card if you need one. Checks for images missing from the folder, low resolution at print size, art with the wrong shape or no bleed, double-sided cards without a back, bad counts, duplicates, sizes that don't fit the paper and empty slots on the last sheet. Exports print-sheets.pdf, backs.pdf and card-list.csv. Runs locally.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 把一文件夹的卡牌图片排成可直接打印的拼版页，适合桌游卡、塔罗、单词卡、名片。可选卡牌尺寸（扑克、桥牌、塔罗、迷你、名片、方形或自定义），设置出血、间距、纸张和裁切线，每张卡打几份可从数量表读取或直接修改。双面打印时每张正面页后跟一张镜像的背面页，长边/短边翻转都能对齐，每张卡也可以有自己的背面。会发现文件夹里缺的图片、按打印尺寸分辨率太低、比例不对或没有出血的卡面、开了双面却没有背面、数量写错、重复列出、尺寸放不下纸张，以及最后一页的空位。导出 print-sheets.pdf、backs.pdf 和 card-list.csv。本地运行。
